result.summary: There are 2 visual issues: a fixed bottom navigation bar is overlapping the content area, and some horizontally scrolling items are clipped at the right edge.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation bar is covering the lower restaurant card, obscuring part of the content.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding/margin to the scrollable content so list items sit fully above the navigation bar.

issues.description: The rightmost category chip and restaurant card are partially cut off at the edge of the screen.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the horizontal carousel has proper edge padding or make it clear that the row is scrollable.
